required.name: Qualified/licensed Electrician
required.hint: A-grade electrician licence; QLD/NSW electrical licence; Australian trade certificate

required.name: Minimum 2 years relevant maintenance/project experience (mining/heavy industry preferred)
required.hint: 2+ years in industrial maintenance, shutdowns, or projects

required.name: Site readiness: Standard 11 OR White Card (either acceptable)

positives.name: Current Coal Board Medical (or ability to obtain)
Engagement in safety leadership or best practices

red_flags.name: Candidate explicitly located outside Australia
red_flags.hint: If location clearly outside AU → red flag. If missing/unclear → mark Unknown.

notes.unknown_policy: If a required item is not explicit in the CV text, mark as Unknown (do not guess). If more than max_unknown_required are Unknown, prefer 'Unsure – Needs Manual Review'.
notes.site_ready_tip: Mark 'site_ready' as met if EITHER Standard 11 OR White Card appears. If neither is clearly stated, set Unknown.
